verdict.rationale: Crossplane's docs say the control plane continuously reconciles and 'automatically corrects the drift' when resources diverge from desired state, so drift detection is inherent to its reconciliation loop. A community comment contrasts this control-plane enforcement favorably with Terraform's drift problems, and the CLI supports troubleshooting managed resources. missing for 10: documentation of how detected drift is surfaced or reported (status conditions, events, diffs), a detect-only/no-auto-correct mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of drift detection.
